output.one_liner: A channel-based messaging platform where teams communicate, integrate tools, and find information within a secure enterprise-grade environment.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 with authorization code grant flow; issued access tokens function as bearer tokens for API requests

evidence.snippet: OAuth 2.0 is a protocol that lets your app request authorization to private details in a user's Slack account
Access tokens for all apps are also known as bearer tokens.
Composio-managed auth works without any setup: create a Slack auth config, choose Composio Managed, and connect.

access.notes: Developers can freely create a Slack workspace, build an app, obtain credentials (Client ID/Client Secret), and test using a free Developer Program sandbox without payment or vendor approval.

evidence.snippet: If you don't have a Slack workspace already, we recommend also setting up a developer sandbox.
Pick features, then click Continue and select the workspace where you'll play around and build your app.
You'll need to register your app before getting started. A registered app is assigned a unique Client ID and Client Secret

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Web API: most methods ≥20 requests/minute; tier-specific limits exist (e.g., chat.postMessage ~1 msg/sec/channel); incoming webhooks: 1/sec, 10k/hour; documented burst tolerance

evidence.snippet: With the integration you can send and read messages, manage channels, upload files, react to events, search conversations, and more
Most methods allow at least 20 requests per minute, while allowing for occasional bursts of more requests.
If your workspace has already installed your application, your request URL will soon begin receiving your configured event subscriptions.
Incoming webhooks are a way to post messages from apps into Slack.
Slack MCP server Server URL https://mcp.slack.com/mcp Remote MCP over HTTP with OAuth.
Try using the Slack MCP Plugin to aid in agent-assisted development.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free credentials, documented REST API with broad method coverage, webhooks, rate limits, and official MCP server enable toolkit building immediately.

overview_evidence.snippet: Slack is a channel-based messaging platform. With Slack, people can work together more effectively, connect all their software tools and services
Composio turns Slack's API into ready-to-use tools that AI agents and automations can call.
